scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Developed around 1975 in Fresno, California, and independently in New York, electric boogaloo emerged as part of the old school hip-hop dance tradition and funk street dance.
It is closely related to the earlier Boogaloo street dance performed in Oakland and to popping, eventually becoming the signature style of the mid-1970s dance group the Electric Boogaloos.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Characterized as a fluid, leg-oriented style utilizing rolls of the hips, knees, legs, and head, combined with popping and the illusion of waves flowing through the body.
Key foundational steps include Creepin, Crazy legs, The Slot (such as the Fresno), Neck-o-flex, Old man, Twist-o-flex, and Walk-out.
Watch for Creepin, Crazy legs, Fresno / The Slot.

Formation: Side-to-side movement in The Slot or Fresno.
